items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: My, my famous grandmother, who I take after, was Suzanne.

ctx.x: And I'm Dick Allen. I want to put our own names on here so that everybody will know what's what. Who's who. Who's who's going on. Who's who.
And, um, I want to say this. My, my famous grandmother, who I take after, was Suzanne. That's French. S-A-Z, how do you spell Suzanne? S-A-S-U-Z-A-N-E. S-U-Z-A-N-E.
